correction.incorrect_claim: shorter byte-constrained returns incur empty ranks
correction.replacement: P@1/5/10, recall@k, MRR and nDCG evaluate the positive-score ranked list before context-budget selection. P@k divides relevant results by fixed k; a ranked list shorter than k has empty ranks. Context byte constraints do not alter this ranking metric.

separate_context_metrics.context_precision: Relevant selected records divided by the count of actually selected records after whole-message byte-budget selection; null for an empty selection.
separate_context_metrics.context_evidence_recall: Largest fraction of required evidence present among acceptable evidence sets after context selection; zero for a positive gold set with no selected evidence.
separate_context_metrics.bounded_absence: Positive-evidence recall/ranking remain undefined when no positive evidence exists; abstention is reported separately and is not proof of semantic absence.
